0排队 1发送中 2完成 3失败 4撤销 5过期 6筛选为空 7定时未开始: 0 queued 1 sending 2 completed 3 failed 4 cancelled 5 expired 6 empty after filtering 7 scheduled, not started
App 推送的友盟通道：按设备 token 单播/列播，或全量广播。与「阿里云」: The Umeng channel for app push notifications: unicast/list-cast by device token, or full broadcast. Same as the "Aliyun" plugin's
iOS 区分生产/测试证书环境；Android 测试模式只发给测试设备: iOS distinguishes production/sandbox certificate environments; Android test mode only sends to test devices
友盟 U-Push：按 device_token 单播/列播（≤500 个），或: Umeng U-Push: unicast/list-cast by device_token (≤500 devices), or full broadcast. Android and iOS each use their own Umeng app (configured per platform in the credential)
友盟控制台 Android 应用的 AppKey。只推 iOS 可留空: The AppKey of the Android app in the Umeng console. Can be left empty if you only push to iOS
多个逗号分隔（≤500）；**留空 = 全量广播**，想清楚再发: Comma-separated for multiple (≤500); **empty = full broadcast** — make sure that's what you want before sending
广播/列播回任务 ID（可查状态/撤销）；单播是消息类，回 msg_id，无任务: Broadcast/list-cast returns a task ID (status can be checked/cancelled); unicast is message-type and returns a msg_id with no task statistics
撤销**尚未发送**的任务类消息（定时任务/排队中）；已下发的收不回: Cancels a task-type message that **hasn't been sent yet** (scheduled / queued); messages already delivered cannot be recalled
查广播/列播任务的下发进度（单播消息类没有任务统计——友盟的约定）: Checks the delivery progress of a broadcast/list-cast task (unicast messages have no task statistics — this is Umeng's convention)
用配好的平台各查一次（拿一个不存在的任务号问状态）——钥匙错当场暴露，不会真推送: Queries each configured platform once (by asking for the status of a non-existent task ID) — a wrong key is exposed immediately, with no real push sent
自定义键值对，客户端点开通知时拿到；形状由你的 App 约定: Custom key-value pairs the client receives when the notification is opened; the shape is defined by your app
